# Genesis Suite — Start Here

Connect all twenty-one systems in one runnable toolkit.

Use when you want the complete planning, execution, adaptation, evidence and release workflow.

## Run locally

Extract the ZIP, open a terminal in this top-level folder, then run:

```sh
npm test
npm run demo
```

Node.js 22.23.2 or later within the 22.x line, or Node.js 24.14.0 or later within the 24.x line. Offline tests and demos need no dependency installation. Live model providers require your own authorized access.

## What you receive

- All twenty-one modules
- integrated runner
- offline demo
- module lock
- Source code, offline tests, a runnable example, and documentation.
- MIT license: permission to use and adapt under the included license.

This package contains the 21-module Genesis Suite. It does not include credentials, model access, model credits, Git history, or private release evidence. You connect live providers and external actions. This is workflow improvement, not model-weight reinforcement learning.

Release: genesis-store-2026-09-13-v2.
